summary: Mason County, WA tower built 1961 in the Olympic NF, reported as 40 or 41 ft; removed or burned in 1967; 2014 and 2022 visits found footings and debris.

facts.design: Treated timber R-6 lookout tower; 41 ft per FFLOS and FireLookout, 40 ft per the 1962 newspaper item quoted by Willhite and Forest Lookouts
facts.status_note: FFLOS says removed in 1967; FireLookout, Willhite and Forest Lookouts say destroyed or burned that year; footings and debris described in 2014 and 2022 accounts

visit.drive_up: Forest road 2421 to a gate, then a walk; high clearance recommended
visit.trail_note: Unmarked trail leaves the road behind the gate and is little used

events.note: Parts flown up by helicopter while a nearby forest fire kept a helicopter staged at the Hoodsport Ranger Station (Willhite)
Built in 1961 per FFLOS; Forest Lookouts says material was hauled in by helicopter during the fire season
Port Angeles Evening News (April 27, 1962, as quoted by Forest Lookouts): a 40 ft tower and lookout house was built, lumber flown in by helicopter; Willhite says the paper reported it finished
Willhite and Forest Lookouts say no longer needed and burned in 1967; FireLookout says destroyed
Army crews disassembled and cleaned a partly burned lookout, per a June 1976 Shelton-Mason Co. Journal article quoted by Willhite; the pieces were piled and burned again
Registered January 17, 2012 as US 1191, WA 92; nominated by Ray Kresek
Willhite's visit: debris pile and much of the lookout lying around the site
Washington Trails Association trip report (Tuesday, Nov. 1, 2022): burned timbers, metal fittings and four tower footings seen

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and FireLookout give a 41 ft tower. The 1962 newspaper item, as quoted by Willhite and Forest Lookouts, says 40 ft. The record keeps 12.2 m (40 ft).

FFLOS gives 1961 and Forest Lookouts says material came in that year. Willhite says parts were flown up in 1960. The 1962 newspaper item, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, says the tower and lookout house were built; Willhite says it was finished.
FFLOS says removed in 1967. FireLookout, Willhite and Forest Lookouts say destroyed or burned that year. The story reports both accounts.

notes_for_editor: Brief height 12.2 m kept; sources say 40 or 41 ft. The WTA trip is dated Tuesday, Nov. 1, 2022 on the page. Access level left unset: trip reports describe a gate on FS road 2421 and mention no permit or closure, but no official status page was found. The FS Olympic NF trail page was fetched but had no Jefferson Ridge text, so it is not cited. The FFLOS registration date (January 17, 2012) matches the brief.
